sources.title: Introducing LLaMA: A foundational, 65-billion-parameter large language model
sources.evidence: Dated February 24, 2023; announces original LLaMA in 7B, 13B, 33B and 65B sizes, text input/output, and noncommercial research release with case-by-case access. The later Llama 2 update banner does not replace this original announcement.

sources.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Original paper Table 2 explicitly reports 13.0B parameters, dimension 5120, 40 heads, 40 layers and 1.0T training tokens. This supports the retained nominal total and distinguishes original LLaMA-13B from later Llama 2. Section 2.2 describes Transformer, RMSNorm, SwiGLU and RoPE; Sections 3.1 and 3.4 evaluate reasoning tasks. The arXiv submission is February 27, after the announcement.

sources.title: Original LLaMA version 1 model card, preserved llama_v1 revision
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Identifies FAIR at Meta AI as developer, version 1, autoregressive Transformer, and model sizes including 13B. Describes a foundational research model without human-feedback training, and a noncommercial bespoke model license. It does not separately report an active count.

sources.title: Original LLaMA Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Implements dense causal multi-head attention, SwiGLU feed-forward layers, RMSNorm, RoPE, token embeddings and output projection; no expert routing. ModelArgs sets max_seq_len=2048. Code header explicitly licenses this software under GPLv3.

sources.title: Original LLaMA release README and weight-download procedure
sources.evidence: Describes checkpoint/tokenizer access by application, followed by approved-request download links and signed URLs. Lists 13B inference with model-parallel degree 2. This establishes released gated checkpoints, not unrestricted downloads.

sources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models, Llama 1 comparison
sources.evidence: Table 1 explicitly lists Llama 1 13B at 2k context, separately from Llama 2 13B at 4k. Appendix A.2.1 states the increase was from 2048 to 4096 tokens. Used only for its directly labeled first-generation comparison.

sources.title: Original LLaMA text generation interface
sources.evidence: The reference generate method accepts string prompts, generation length, temperature and top-p and returns decoded strings. It caps prompt plus continuation at max_seq_len; it exposes no separate thinking channel or structured tool-call interface.

sources.title: Original LLaMA repository software license
sources.evidence: Repository LICENSE contains GNU GPL version 3. Combined with the explicit software notice in model.py, this is code-license evidence; the weight-license classification instead follows the original model card and release announcement.

sources.title: JetMoE original project page, active-parameter comparison
sources.evidence: Freshly accessed October 27, 2026. The original project benchmark table explicitly labels Active Params and lists LLaMA-13B as 13B with 1T training tokens, separately from LLaMA2-7B at 7B with 2T tokens. The 1T original-model row agrees with the original LLaMA paper. This establishes the JetMoE research team's nominal active-count comparison convention, not a Meta active-parameter disclosure or exact tensor participation count.

sources.title: JetMoE-8B original team model card, pinned active-count table
sources.evidence: Freshly accessed October 27, 2026. The pinned team-authored README explicitly labels Activate Params; the LLaMA-13B row reports 13B and 1T training tokens, while LLaMA2-7B reports 7B and 2T. The separately labeled chat table also distinguishes Llama-2-13b-chat. This corroborates the project page for the original base LLaMA 13B identity. The table publishes a nominal comparison count without defining exact embedding inclusion or per-token tensor participation.

sources.title: JetMoE technical report, version 1
sources.evidence: Freshly accessed October 27, 2026. The report identifies the JetMoE authors and describes its sparse activation convention. Its abstract and evaluation distinguish Llama2-7B and Llama2-13B-Chat; the original LLaMA-13B active-count evidence used here is the explicit project-page and pinned-card table rather than a transfer from those Llama 2 rows.

name.note: Original first-generation 13B model; not Llama 2 13B or an instruction-tuned derivative.

developer.note: The model card identifies the FAIR team of Meta AI.

family.note: LLaMA is the developer-named family; catalog lowercase family key is appropriate.

release_date.note: Explicit public announcement date, with access applications and subsequent approval-gated weight delivery. February 27 is the later arXiv submission; no individual approval date is inferred.

open_weights.note: Historical gated research-weight release. This field does not mean unrestricted or OSI-open distribution, and current application fulfillment was not tested.

license.note: Supported descriptive weight-license label. The original card says noncommercial bespoke license; repository GPLv3 covers software. Neither GPLv3 nor the later Llama 2 license should replace the weight-license label. Full original weight-agreement text was not separately verified.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source check retains the published nominal total: original Meta Table 2 reports 13.0B, and the version-1 model card lists 13B. This is a rounded specification, not a tensor-exact checkpoint census.

active_parameters_b.note: JetMoE's original research-team benchmark table explicitly publishes 13B active for LLaMA-13B. Its 1T training-token row and separate LLaMA2-7B row identify the original model, matching Meta's paper. Retain this nominal JetMoE comparison convention; it is not a separate Meta disclosure or an exact per-token count, and embedding inclusion is not specified. The value is sourced independently of the dense architecture or total count.

architecture.note: Autoregressive decoder Transformer with ordinary dense attention and SwiGLU blocks. The exact 13B row has 40 layers, 40 heads and width 5120; reference code has no expert router.

context_window.note: Original code uses 2048; later first-party Table 1 explicitly assigns 2k to Llama 1 13B, and Appendix A.2.1 resolves this as 2048. This is the original context, not a modified checkpoint extension.

modalities.note: Release describes word-sequence continuation; original generator accepts and returns text strings.

reasoning.note: Reasoning benchmark performance is documented, but it does not establish a dedicated thinking mode or separate reasoning output. No such feature is specified for this base checkpoint.

tool_call.note: No native structured tool/function-call feature is documented in the original card or text-completion interface. This is not a claim that downstream prompted integrations are impossible.

description.note: Accurate concise description of the version-1 foundational research checkpoint.

patch.notes: Original first-generation LLaMA 13B. Total parameters follow Meta's rounded 13.0B specification; nominal active 13B follows the JetMoE research team's comparison table, which does not specify exact per-token participation or embedding inclusion. Release date is the February 24, 2023 announcement and access-request opening; weights were delivered after case-by-case research approval. open_weights denotes released gated weights. Weights use a bespoke noncommercial research license; reference code uses GPLv3. Dedicated thinking mode and native tool calling are not documented.

sources.label: JetMoE team comparison: original LLaMA-13B active parameters
JetMoE pinned model card: LLaMA-13B nominal active count

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit on October 27, 2026 reopens the original Meta paper and version-1 card and checks later active/activated-parameter comparisons. Retained nominal total 13B from Meta's explicit 13.0B Table 2 row; changed active parameters from undisclosed to verified nominal 13B using JetMoE's original project-page and pinned-card comparison. The exact LLaMA-13B/1T row distinguishes the original base model from the separate LLaMA2-7B/2T and Llama-2-13b-chat rows. The active count is attributed to the JetMoE research team, not Meta, and does not establish exact tensor participation or embedding inclusion. The JetMoE paper was also checked without transferring later-generation counts. Both parameter values have explicit patches. The other 12 field assessments are unchanged; no weights were downloaded.
